## Goal

Give pij-spawned Copilot Claude seats a 1-hour prompt cache through the `pij-rs cache-proxy` sidecar (PRD 004, blueprint 003), proven on live seats against every row of the acceptance matrix (governance handover/cache-proxy-test-matrix.md).
